purpose: Add managed person names, department and position display directories, immutable name history, optimistic revisions, lifecycle flags, and hierarchy-cycle protection.
lockImpact: Creates additive tables, indexes, function, and trigger. Runtime department moves take a transaction-scoped advisory lock dedicated to the management hierarchy.
dataImpact: Additive only; existing effective-dated organization facts are not rewritten.
backfill: Not required. Existing facts remain valid and management profiles are populated by reviewed bootstrap or management commands.
recovery: Leave the additive tables in place and forward-fix. Do not delete name history after population.
forwardFix: Append a reviewed organization-owned migration for later directory changes.
